scripts.test: vitest run && npm run test:build && npm run test:render-timing-report
scripts.test:e2e:export: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.export.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:graph: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.graph.config.ts
scripts.test:federation: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.federation.config.ts
scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && node scripts/normalize-federation-types.ts dist/@mf-types.zip && npm run verify:federation
scripts.test:coverage-ledger: node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include=**/scripts/coverage-ledger.ts --test-coverage-lines=100 --test-coverage-branches=100 --test-coverage-functions=100 scripts/coverage-ledger.node-test.ts && vitest run --coverage && node scripts/coverage-ledger.ts check coverage/ledger/coverage-summary.json coverage-ledger.json
scripts.test:e2e:timing: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.timing.config.ts
